shape: hyperlocal tier-3 Indian real estate developer with thin web presence and no founder-uploaded reference images — stresses the binder's hardest disciplines simultaneously
notes: Held-out fixture (corpus brand; the research binder has no worked examples, so the held-out concern is structural failure-mode coverage rather than example leakage). This single fixture exercises: (1) the depth dial reaching hyperlocal — apprentice must read reference/hyperlocal.md and surface the three additional probes (language register, cultural anchors, sub-culture identity) in §3; (2) graceful degradation under thin brand-specific web presence — Arjun Infra has only a JustDial listing and a 99acres PDF, no dedicated website, no review base — so §1 must lean on third-party signal and §8 must name the gaps; (3) the buyer-as-person probe dominant over buyer-as-customer because reviews are absent — §2 must lift via category-level Telugu real-estate creator content, AP property forums, NRI Andhra investment discussion; (4) gap-naming for visual reality — no founder-uploaded reference images for a visual-first vertical, so §4 must name the absence and try to triangulate with what stranger-supplied imagery is reachable; (5) the surface-matching discipline — formal aggregator listings carry landmark anchors but not buyer register; YouTube creator content carries register; the apprentice must route each probe to the right surface class. The fixture is also empirically grounded — Perplexity Agent API runs against this brand were validated 2026-05-20.
